turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, am I speaking with Mrs. Khan?

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Yes, this is she. Who is calling please?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Namaste, I am Sameer from the logistics team in Pune. I have a large parcel here for you.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: A parcel? I am not expecting anything today.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: It is the home appliance you ordered last week, the one for twelve thousand rupees.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Oh, the air purifier! My son told me he bought it, but I forgot.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Yes, that is the one. I am currently near the main market, so I wanted to check if you are home.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: I am here, but my gate is locked. Will you be able to find the side entrance?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I can do that. Just please keep the gate open so my helper can carry the box inside.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Alright, let me go and open it now. How long will you take?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I will be there in about ten minutes, Mrs. Khan.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Okay beta, I am waiting. See you soon.
